verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a pay-as-you-go, per-second-billing model and offers account/workspace-level budget tracking (databricks-docs-21, databricks-docs-58/61/83), which gives some basis for estimating spend, but there is no detailed unit-pricing/DBU-rate breakdown or worked example in the evidence, and community reports concretely contradict the ease of estimation, calling the platform 'crazy expensive' and citing 'SO MANY limitations and surprise gotchas' specifically around serverless pricing (databricks-comm-2, databricks-comm-4). This is a real hands-on contradiction of the 'estimate before committing' claim, not mere general skepticism. Missing for 10: a transparent unit-price/DBU rate table, a documented cost calculator or worked estimation example, and independent confirmation that estimates match actual bills.
